strategy.thesis: Sovereign co-investment program: Taiwan's National Development Fund (國發基金) earmarked NT$10 billion to invest — via its existing panel of appointed investment-project offices — into domestic 'smart healthcare' (智慧醫療) innovation companies, i.e. digital health, telehealth and health-IT ventures, alongside private investors.

summary.en: A Taiwan government co-investment program under the National Development Fund that earmarked NT$10 billion (Sept 2024) to back domestic smart-healthcare / digital-health startups alongside private-sector investors, executed through existing NDF-appointed investment offices.
summary.local: 國家發展基金於2024年9月匡列新台幣100億元辦理「投資智慧醫療創新創業計畫」，透過既有國發基金相關投資專案辦公室，投資國內智慧醫療（數位健康）創新相關企業，並帶動民間資金共同投資。
